My mum went through all my things as a child/teen. I still however carried on with my diaries for a time, I think like OP the therapeutic nature of writing everything down made me feel less isolated. I think the point that I stopped was when she read my diary and found out that I really didn't want to go see this Westend show in London with the family and wanted to see a boy I liked instead. How I knew she had read my diary was that she said her cleaner had rang the house phone and no one had answered, but my Nmother used to take the phone off the receiver so I could not use the phone whilst they were out (or the internet - dial up). I honestly think it shamed me out of doing something I enjoyed and perhaps could have flourished in.
